headline: Trump says he expects to meet Xi, and possibly Putin, at the APEC summit in Shenzhen on Nov 18-19 (#3072). This would be the 'November in China' meeting he announced after the Sep 24 Washington summit (#3066). Not yet held.
The record $14 billion Taiwan arms package is still paused; Taiwan's defense minister said on Nov 5 he expects US support to continue after the midterms (#3064).
The State Department said it is 'deeply concerned' after Taiwan closed its Papua New Guinea office on Nov 6, blaming Chinese pressure (#3071). Words only.

No US transit, patrol, arms notification, drill or trade step against China, and no named PLA drill or coast-guard clash, was found in an allowed outlet for Nov 2-8. Higher PLA air activity around Taiwan on Nov 3 is reported only by outlets not on the allowed list (not confirmed).
Small numbers: most options have only a handful of counted cases.
